mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees under clear skies at Verona Community Park with a beautiful Waxing Gibbous moon, and tonight will see an overnight low of 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

Important reminder for the community as we approach the holiday: city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27. Additionally, the City is planning for a new Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population, focusing on efficiency and sustainable design.

We have a packed schedule of local entertainment! Live music is playing at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's tomorrow, with more music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company on Saturday. Looking ahead to next week, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness on November 23 and various trivia nights starting November 25.

Regarding the weekly police report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old Verona man for battery and disorderly conduct.

Culver's of Verona is currently closed for the night. You missed out on the Really Reese's today, but look forward to the opening tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Crazy for Cookie Dough.
